Class JpaWalletQueryAdapter

java.lang.Object
com.kerosene.kfe.wallet.adapters.out.persistence.JpaWalletQueryAdapter
All Implemented Interfaces:
WalletQueryPort
@Component public final class JpaWalletQueryAdapter extends Object implements WalletQueryPort
Implements wallet reads by mapping owner-scoped JPA entities into immutable domain snapshots.
